description: RFC 8785 serializer cases within the allowed value set. canonicalize: parsing input with JSON.parse and serializing MUST give canonical. refuse: parsing input with JSON.parse gives a value the serializer MUST refuse.

canonicalize.description: RFC 8785 section 3.2.3 property sorting by UTF-16 code units
canonicalize.input:
{
  "1": "One",
  "€": "Euro Sign",
  "\r": "Carriage Return",
  "דּ": "Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh",
  "😀": "Emoji: Grinning Face",
  "": "Control",
  "ö": "Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"
}
canonicalize.canonical: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

canonicalize.description: nested arrays and objects sort at every depth
integers at the safe bounds, negative zero, and an integer written with a fraction and exponent
U+007F and U+2028 are emitted literally; U+001F is escaped in lowercase

refuse.description: an exponent beyond the safe range
a lone low surrogate inside an object key
